description: Get the full record of one property on Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet), including legal description, valuation, property tax status, Property checks (with their 5-digit numeric encoding), current ownership and holders, active loans, marketplace listings and offers, recent activity, photos and a parcel map image link. Also its lifecycle stage (unclaimed, being added, replaced, live, removal in progress, removed, retired), fees assessed on the token with approval and payment state (fees is null when none are assessed), and flags for a duplicate parcel claim or the marketplace screen (an empty list when none apply). A token ID that was replaced when the property's token was issued returns that issued token. Boundary geometry is returned by get_land_boundary. Pass display: "fullscreen" to ask a host that renders the property card to open it fullscreen (the host may decline). Owner names: the majority holder's chosen display name is returned; the deed grantor from Fabrica's own records is in get_land_trust_documents; owner names from third-party parcel data are never returned.

display.description: Hosts that render the property card: ask for it inline (default) or fullscreen. The host may decline.

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property
